frozen_source_snapshot.limitation: Replay reads committed sources; original GBIF/GLAD original acquisition and SDM fitting are separate.

source_eligibility.note: Potential within modeled guilds and source-native acoustic event records, not universal regional species richness.

primary_claims.result: Whole-region Odonata suitability negatively associated with strong-calling visit fraction
primary_claims.estimand: Spearman rho of site strong-call visit fraction against modeled mean Odonata suitability percentile
primary_claims.uncertainty: route-resampling conditional on already fitted SDM
primary_claims.claim_ceiling: No observed Odonata nymph density; no ecological predator avoidance.

primary_claims.result: High pond-breeding Caudata suitability strata show more negative Odonata–calling correlation
primary_claims.estimand: High minus low stratum Spearman rho, same original primary cohort and background
primary_claims.uncertainty: source route bootstrap conditional on fitted niches; exploratory multiple tests not adjusted
primary_claims.claim_ceiling: Low uniform rho interval overlaps zero; no causal facilitation, competition, trophic release or confirmed sign reversal.

primary_claims.result: Landscape flooded vegetation modifies guild associations in some model backgrounds
primary_claims.estimand: rank-standardized three-way vegetation×Odonata suitability×pond-Caudata suitability in full model with lower-order terms
primary_claims.uncertainty: 1000 original route resamples, same remote source, one-km sensitivity
primary_claims.claim_ceiling: Static EarthEnv flooded land cover, not observed emergent stems, shelter or vegetation seasonal emergence.

primary_claims.result: Previous-year conditional water pixel detection lower at strong-call member of fixed pair
primary_claims.estimand: Strong minus silent, satellite classified-water frequency restricted to ever-water 3-km pixels, in percentage points
primary_claims.uncertainty: 2000 resamples of connected physical-site route components
primary_claims.claim_ceiling: Water detection frequency of source-classified pixels, not breeding pool hydroperiod or continuous inundation days; conditional n excludes no-water pixels.

primary_claims.result: Strong recorded acoustic use is associated with more strict past strong calling at same listening stop
primary_claims.estimand: Strong member minus silent member source strictly prior strong-visit proportion, in percentage points
primary_claims.uncertainty: 2000 original-site-linked route component resamples and independent strict-prior-history recomputation
primary_claims.claim_ceiling: Site-history proxy may capture habitat and detection. Neither tracked returning individuals nor philopatry.

supporting_negative_result.contrast: Adding modeled guild richness or composition to strict history in route-held-out fixed-pair allocation model
supporting_negative_result.outcome: No clear out-of-route additional predictive gain; does not eliminate whole-region exploratory correlations

non_identified: Observed pond-specific trophic contacts or predator larvae population size
Specific lake-pond identity of NAAMP roadside listening stops
Measured submergent/emergent shelter or plants seasonal sprouting phenology
Field-confirmed drying and refilling duration of specific breeding ponds
Individual philopatry or tracked return to an acoustic site
Causal species competition / mesopredator trophic release
Uncertainty in SDM estimates fully propagated through all correlation intervals
next_synthesis_policy: Keep macro correlation, guild conditioning, preceding remote water, vegetation and history in the main results. RC6-only nulls and stage experiments remain in origin and future-mechanism files, not additional main figures.
